title: Monitoring latency, time to first token and failures

videos.script: A streamed answer has three clocks. How long the screen stays empty. How fast the words come once they start. And how long the whole thing takes. {{clocks}} Over a week, most answers take three seconds, and the slowest take eleven. The mean describes neither. {{tail}} Long answers are slow answers. Long prompts are slower to start. And in production, some calls are slow for reasons that have nothing to do with their size. {{drivers}} Then failures. A small proxy is told to refuse three attempts in ten, and the customers notice nothing, because the assistant retries. {{retry}} Let the SDK retry instead, and the trace shows one slow success. The proxy's log shows three requests. {{hidden}} A reply can stop half way, after the customer has started reading it. {{cut}} And a timeout is chosen from the percentiles, on the first token, not on the whole call. {{timeout}}
